svg.title: Homelab
svg.desc: Homelab (LIVE, SELF-HOSTED): Raspberry Pi 5 production node. Debian 13 box running 30+ Docker services behind Cloudflare Zero Trust and Twingate, with GitOps backups. Built with Docker, Debian 13, Zero Trust.
svg.text: Debian 13 box running 30+ Docker services behind
Cloudflare Zero Trust and Twingate, with GitOps
